_comment: Localization for BPRUE DLC1 signature modules.

languages.English: Subsonic Specialist
Tunes the AK9 around its heavy subsonic role with increased armor penetration and improved recoil control, at the cost of effective range.
Featherweight Assembly
Pushes the Arev Light's lightweight identity further with lower weight and faster aiming, at the cost of increased recoil.
Breaching Configuration
Builds the Clapper into a heavier, more controlled close-range shotgun with tighter dispersion and reduced recoil.
Indestructible
Reinforces the Defender into an exceptionally durable heavy shotgun with reduced wear per shot, at the cost of even more weight.
Duty Service Package
A disciplined service-rifle tune for the Dnipro Duty that improves recoil control and reduces weapon wear, at the cost of additional weight.
Airborne Marksman
Pushes the Fallschirmjager toward mobile precision with tighter dispersion, faster aiming and lower weight, at the cost of stronger recoil.
Match Fire-Control Group
Refines the HSG72's precision identity with tighter dispersion, lower recoil and increased armor penetration.
Freedom Overclock
Overdrives the Kharod Freedom for a higher fire rate, accepting stronger recoil and accelerated weapon wear.
Flechette Specialist
Pushes the SPSA Sniper toward armored targets with substantially higher armor penetration and tighter dispersion, at the cost of raw damage.
CQB Conversion
Commits the SVU CQB to close-range fighting with much faster aiming and lower recoil, at the cost of effective range.
Lightweight Marksman Kit
Further lightens the Tundra for faster handling and aiming, trading some recoil control for mobility.
Warsaw Pact Tuning
Tunes the Warszawa's 5.45 configuration for faster, more controllable automatic fire, at the cost of additional weapon weight.
